title: Persona Waves · Sep 30
scope: Two local runs of 100 personas each on a dev build with the course enrollment bypass. No Supabase, Stripe, or AI-provider keys and no outbound network, so payment, inquiry, lab, certificate and some form flows are marked as not tested.

findings.title: No way forward at the end of a module
findings.summary: Modules run Understand → Try → Build → Save, but the only Next-module button sat at the bottom of Build. On phones the module list is folded away, so learners finishing Save saw no way to continue.
evidence: All 16 mobile learners hit it, 3–10 times each
Save ended with “Next: carry it into …” and no link
After the fix, 5 mobile learners re-run: 0 dead ends (were 3–10 each)
findings.fix: Save now ends with “Replay, then continue · Module N”. It unlocks in the same visit when Build completes the module. Commit 3a20bbae, 5 new tests.

findings.title: Exam could be passed by always choosing “b”
findings.summary: 37 of 41 exam answers were “b” and options were never shuffled. Answering “b” to every question scored 83%, “Advanced”.
findings.fix: Options are shuffled every time an exam is drawn and lettered by position; scoring keys are unchanged. A test proves fixed-position guessing stays near chance.

findings.title: Exam’s correct answer is almost always the longest
findings.summary: In 39 of 40 questions the correct option is the longest. Even with shuffling, “pick the longest answer” passes. Distractors need rewriting to similar length and specificity.
findings.fix: Course content: rewrite distractors, then add a content test that fails if more than 40% of correct answers are the longest.

findings.title: Sample report “Send PDF” was fake
findings.summary: The form said “Summary on its way. Check your inbox” but sent nothing and captured no lead.
findings.fix: Now posts to /api/capture-email with the sample report; offers a direct download if sending fails. 2 tests.

findings.title: Course home never links to the certificate
findings.summary: All 10 completers had to type the certificate address. The course home has no link to the final packet, certificate, or post-assessment. Only the end-of-module-18 card and the dashboard link to the packet.
evidence: Course home HTML contains no submit, certificate, or post-assessment link
findings.fix: Course home now shows a “Course complete” card linking to submit packet, certificate, and growth check. The certificate outage screen also links to the packet and support.

findings.title: Free downloads failed whenever the database was unreachable
findings.summary: The download route returned 503 before reaching its own static-file fallback, and visitors landed on a raw JSON error page.
evidence: Prompt card, playbook and template downloads returned 503 locally
findings.fix: Free files are served straight from the deploy; paid files stay gated. 2 tests. Raw-JSON error pages for other failures remain open (plan B2).

findings.title: Module 3 save is locked behind a prompt score
findings.summary: The CORE prompt workshop offers “Save & continue” only after the learner’s prompt passes C·O·R·E scoring. Synthetic learners typing generic text never passed. Real learners will do better, but this is the one step with no way past a failing score.
evidence: 6 of 30 synthetic learners could not save module 3
findings.fix: Check in real sessions: after repeated failed attempts, is there a hint or an exit?

findings.title: Account pages showed a developer error to visitors
findings.summary: Sign-up, sign-in and password reset showed “Auth is not configured. Set Supabase environment variables.” when auth was down.
findings.fix: Replaced with a plain message and the support email.

findings.title: Course settings Save disabled with no explanation
findings.summary: Save stays disabled until all three profile questions are answered, with nothing saying so.
findings.fix: Adds “Answer all three questions to save.”

findings.title: React “unique key” warning on every module page
findings.summary: Development-only console warning on every module page. Not visible to learners, but it hides real warnings. It comes from content ModulePage passes into ModuleTabs; the tab bar’s own keys are fine.

findings.title: Marketing pages have no main landmark
findings.summary: “Skip to main content” targets a plain div, and the home, assessment, resources, courses, institutions, practice, and verify pages have no <main> element. Course pages already have their own, so check nesting before changing the shared wrapper.
evidence: 26 personas saw it on the home page alone

findings.title: In-Depth upgrade not found from some free results
findings.summary: 3 of 8 In-Depth buyers found no upgrade button on their free result and typed the address. The other 5 found “Get 90-day playbook”. May depend on the result variant, or be a harness miss.

findings.title: “Download prompt card” gave no file or message
findings.summary: On the Prompt Like a Banker page, clicking Download produced no file and no confirmation for 3 personas. Most likely the download route needs the database, which was missing here. Root cause was the database-only download path; now served from the deploy.

plan.done: Every wave-1 rage-quit traced to a product dead end, and all four causes are fixed. Wave 2 had no rage-quits.
definition: Every goal-directed persona reaches value (explorers excluded)
0 product dead ends: no page without a way forward, no raw error
Every failure shows a plain message and a next step

steps.title: Run both waves on a configured preview
steps.detail: Stripe test keys, Supabase, AI keys, Resend test mode. Every remaining “env” row becomes a real result: checkout, inquiries, downloads, lab, certificate, resume links, support, quick wins, accounts, cookbook, exam saving.

steps.title: Rewrite exam distractors
steps.detail: Correct answer is the longest option in 39 of 40 questions. Balance length and specificity, then add a guard test.

steps.title: No raw JSON for failed downloads
steps.detail: Browser navigations to failing /api download routes should get a readable page or a redirect with a message.

steps.title: Module 3 workshop exit
steps.detail: Hint after 3 failed CORE attempts; “Save with coach notes” after 6.

steps.title: Silent artifact saves
steps.detail: 3 of 320 saves gave no feedback. Reproduce on the preview.

steps.title: In-Depth button on every free result
steps.detail: 3 of 8 buyers could not find it.
